vrextensions:v_wheat_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_wheat_root.text: The wheat is finally turning golden across the fields.

vrextensions:p_wheat_help.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_wheat_help.text: Need a hand harvesting it later?

vrextensions:p_wheat_smell.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_wheat_smell.text: I can already smell the fresh bread.

vrextensions:v_wheat_glad.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_wheat_glad.text: That would be wonderful, thank you for offering!

vrextensions:v_wheat_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_wheat_neutral.text: I will manage the harvest myself, but I appreciate the thought.

vrextensions:v_pumpkin_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_pumpkin_root.text: The pumpkins have taken over the entire patch again.

vrextensions:p_pumpkin_pie.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_pumpkin_pie.text: Think of all the pumpkin pies we can bake!

vrextensions:p_pumpkin_carve.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_pumpkin_carve.text: We should carve silly faces into them.

vrextensions:v_pumpkin_pie_glad.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_pumpkin_pie_glad.text: Hmph... I suppose one pie wouldn't hurt anyone.

vrextensions:v_pumpkin_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_pumpkin_neutral.text: They are just gourds. Nothing to get worked up over.

vrextensions:v_carrot_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_carrot_root.text: The soil in this village yields the most resilient carrots.

vrextensions:p_carrot_golden.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_carrot_golden.text: Good soil makes for a golden harvest.

vrextensions:p_carrot_pig.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_carrot_pig.text: Just make sure the pigs don't eat them all.

vrextensions:v_carrot_wise_nod.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_carrot_wise_nod.text: Indeed. A well-tended root grows strong enough to crack stone.

vrextensions:v_carrot_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_carrot_neutral.text: The crops are growing as expected.

vrextensions:v_spring_rain_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_spring_rain_root.text: The spring rain is so refreshing after a long winter.

vrextensions:p_spring_rain_flirt.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_spring_rain_flirt.text: It's even more beautiful when I get to share it with you.

vrextensions:p_spring_rain_mud.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_spring_rain_mud.text: It just makes my armor rust and the paths muddy.

vrextensions:v_spring_rain_blush.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_spring_rain_blush.text: You always know exactly what to say to make me smile.

vrextensions:v_spring_rain_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_spring_rain_neutral.text: Rain is just rain, I suppose.

vrextensions:v_thunder_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_thunder_root.text: The sky looks angry today. A bad storm is brewing.

vrextensions:p_thunder_brave.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_thunder_brave.text: Don't worry, I'll protect you if lightning strikes near the village.

vrextensions:p_thunder_scared.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_thunder_scared.text: We should really head inside before things get worse.

vrextensions:v_thunder_protect.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_thunder_protect.text: Hah! Let the storm try. We can face anything together.

vrextensions:v_thunder_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_thunder_neutral.text: The weather changes quickly here. We will endure.

vrextensions:v_compost_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_compost_root.text: I've been tossing all the excess seeds into the composter.

vrextensions:p_compost_efficient.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_compost_efficient.text: That's a very efficient way to get more bonemeal.

vrextensions:p_compost_smell.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_compost_smell.text: It works, but it smells absolutely terrible.

vrextensions:v_compost_profits.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_compost_profits.text: Exactly! Wasted seeds are wasted emeralds, as I always say.

vrextensions:v_compost_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_compost_neutral.text: Dirt into fertilizer, fertilizer into crops. It is the cycle.

vrextensions:v_hoe_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_hoe_root.text: My iron hoe snapped cleanly in half this morning.

vrextensions:p_hoe_sympathy.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_hoe_sympathy.text: I can forge a diamond one for you if you'd like.

vrextensions:p_hoe_laugh.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_hoe_laugh.text: Tough luck. You'll have to use cobblestone for now.

vrextensions:v_hoe_snapped.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_hoe_snapped.text: A diamond hoe? That would cut through the soil like butter!

vrextensions:v_hoe_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_hoe_neutral.text: A broken tool will not stop a day's work. I will craft another.

vrextensions:v_drought_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_drought_root.text: The summer heat is relentless. The crops are barely holding on.

vrextensions:p_drought_water.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_drought_water.text: I'll bring some buckets from the river to help irrigate.

vrextensions:p_drought_ignore.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_drought_ignore.text: They'll probably survive until the next rain.

vrextensions:v_drought_thanks.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_drought_thanks.text: That would... that would save the entire harvest. Thank you.

vrextensions:v_drought_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_drought_neutral.text: We will just have to wait and see what happens.

vrextensions:v_autumn_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_autumn_root.text: The birch leaves are turning such beautiful colors.

vrextensions:p_autumn_walk.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_autumn_walk.text: We should take a walk through the forest later.

vrextensions:p_autumn_rake.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_autumn_rake.text: It just means more sweeping for us when they fall.

vrextensions:v_autumn_eager.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_autumn_eager.text: I'd love that! We can gather saplings while we're out.

vrextensions:v_autumn_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_autumn_neutral.text: The seasons change, just as they always do.

vrextensions:v_blizzard_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_blizzard_root.text: The snow is piling up so fast outside.

vrextensions:p_blizzard_cuddle.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_blizzard_cuddle.text: Let's stay inside by the furnace and keep each other warm.

vrextensions:p_blizzard_cold.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_blizzard_cold.text: Don't let the crops freeze while you're standing around.

vrextensions:v_blizzard_warm.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_blizzard_warm.text: I wouldn't want to weather this storm with anyone else.

vrextensions:v_siege_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_siege_root.text: I heard zombies banging on the village doors all night during the storm.

vrextensions:p_siege_safe.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_siege_safe.text: Don't worry, I cleared the perimeter. You're safe.

vrextensions:p_siege_weapons.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_siege_weapons.text: Maybe you should learn how to hold a sword instead of hiding.

vrextensions:v_siege_ready.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_siege_ready.text: Knowing you're out there on patrol keeps me sane.

vrextensions:v_siege_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_siege_neutral.text: The wooden doors held up fine, thankfully.

vrextensions:v_trade_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_trade_root.text: The wandering trader offered me kelp for three emeralds. Ridiculous.

vrextensions:p_trade_buy.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_trade_buy.text: We should grow our own and sell it back to him.

vrextensions:p_trade_expensive.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_trade_expensive.text: At least his llamas are mildly entertaining.

vrextensions:v_trade_profit.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_trade_profit.text: Hah! Now that is a brilliant business strategy.

vrextensions:v_trade_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_trade_neutral.text: His trade deals were not optimal for my resources.

vrextensions:v_bees_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_bees_root.text: The bees are very active around the crops today.

vrextensions:p_bees_honey.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_bees_honey.text: They're helping the plants grow. We'll have plenty of honey soon.

vrextensions:p_bees_sting.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_bees_sting.text: Just don't make them angry, or they'll swarm you.

vrextensions:v_bees_smile.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_bees_smile.text: I can't wait! Honey blocks make the best decorations.

vrextensions:v_bees_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_bees_neutral.text: They are industrious insects. I will leave them be.

vrextensions:v_fish_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_fish_root.text: They say fish bite more frequently when it rains.

vrextensions:p_fish_join.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_fish_join.text: Want to grab some rods and find out together?

vrextensions:p_fish_wet.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_fish_wet.text: I'm not standing out in the rain just for a raw salmon.

vrextensions:v_fish_accept.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_fish_accept.text: Yes! Let me grab my lucky bobber from the chest.

vrextensions:v_fish_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_fish_neutral.text: I will probably just buy fish from the fisherman later.

vrextensions:v_water_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_water_root.text: The irrigation trenches are flowing perfectly today.

vrextensions:p_water_life.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_water_life.text: Your hard work keeping the water moving is paying off.

vrextensions:p_water_drown.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_water_drown.text: Just don't fall in. I don't want to fish you out.

vrextensions:v_water_philosophy.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_water_philosophy.text: Thank you. Water gives life, but only when carefully guided.

vrextensions:v_water_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_water_neutral.text: The water flows where it is dug. Nothing more.

vrextensions:v_glass_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_glass_root.text: I was thinking of building a glass roof over the tender crops.

vrextensions:p_glass_help.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_glass_help.text: I can smelt a bunch of sand for you in the blast furnace.

vrextensions:p_glass_fragile.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_glass_fragile.text: Glass is fragile. One skeleton arrow and it's all ruined.

vrextensions:v_glass_excited.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_glass_excited.text: That would save me so much time! A greenhouse would be perfect.

vrextensions:v_glass_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_glass_neutral.text: It was just a thought for the future.

vrextensions:v_hail_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_hail_root.text: That sudden hail really battered the melon patches.

vrextensions:p_hail_salvage.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_hail_salvage.text: Let's go salvage what we can before it rots.

vrextensions:p_hail_badluck.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_hail_badluck.text: Looks like a total loss this time.

vrextensions:v_hail_harsh.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_hail_harsh.text: With your help, we might save enough seeds to start over.

vrextensions:v_hail_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_hail_neutral.text: The weather is unforgiving. I will clean it up eventually.

vrextensions:v_mud_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_mud_root.text: The constant drizzle has turned the village square into a swamp.

vrextensions:p_mud_clean.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_mud_clean.text: I can lay down some gravel to make the paths walkable.

vrextensions:p_mud_jump.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_mud_jump.text: The pigs seem to love it, at least.

vrextensions:v_mud_relieved.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_mud_relieved.text: Oh, that would be wonderful. My boots are ruined.

vrextensions:v_mud_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_mud_neutral.text: It is quite messy to walk through.

vrextensions:v_sunflower_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_sunflower_root.text: I love how the sunflowers always face the sunrise.

vrextensions:p_sunflower_sun.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_sunflower_sun.text: It's a very practical way to figure out which way is East.

vrextensions:v_sunflower_blush.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_sunflower_blush.text: Oh, you... making me blush this early in the morning!

vrextensions:v_beetroot_root.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_beetroot_root.text: I finished harvesting the beetroots. I'll be making soup tonight.

vrextensions:p_beetroot_share.speaker: player
vrextensions:p_beetroot_share.text: Can I join you for dinner? Your soup is the best.

vrextensions:v_beetroot_grudging.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_beetroot_grudging.text: Fine, fine. I will set an extra wooden bowl on the table for you.

vrextensions:v_beetroot_neutral.speaker: villager
vrextensions:v_beetroot_neutral.text: It is a nutritious meal, regardless of the taste.
